samir: Postmortem follow-up: boiled down to three quick tracks — repro capture, short-term tenant guardrail, and slab GC experiments. Assign owners/ETAs here.
elaine: I'll run deterministic repros on staging and gather heap/alloc traces. Will try skew sweep 0.6->0.95.
yusuf: I'll do canary slab changes: bump frag_threshold and tighten compact window. Will gate behind feature flag.
morgan: ops will add residency-delta alert and implement a temporary per-tenant soft-multiplier (default 0.9x, opt-out) for 48h. Also will schedule synthetic eviction cron.
ops-bot: runbook: infra/runbooks/kv-residency-guard.md; synthetic job template: infra/jobs/kv_eviction_smoke.yaml
samir: repro guidance (elaine): 4–6h peak run, alloc-sample=1%, upload bundles to s3://redwood-inference-dev/kv-traces/2476543210/. Add meta file with qps/skew/sha.
elaine: command I'll use:
```bash
TRACE_DIR=/tmp/kvtrace
./kv_repro --pool=staging --clients=130 --skew-start=0.6 --skew-end=0.95 --duration=21600 --alloc-sample=1% --out=$TRACE_DIR/t.tgz
```
yusuf: canary plan highlights:
- frag_threshold: 0.35 -> 0.5 (48h)
- compact-window for hotspots 60s -> 30s (72h)
- eager-evict segments>96MB on canary (72h)
Rollback criteria: any OOM or p99_read_latency >1.7x baseline.
morgan: alerts/tasks:
- residency-delta >18% sustained 10m -> page oncall
- tenant soft-multiplier 0.9x for >95th percentile for 48h (opt-out)
- synthetic eviction cron at 02:30 UTC
samir: ownership recap (confirm): repro: elaine (ETA 24h); canary GC experiments: yusuf (PR 24h, canary start after review); guardrail/alerts: morgan/ops (ETA 6h); retro writeup: samir (ETA 2026-06-12). Reconvene in 48h with metrics. If canary sees OOM, page #eng-oncall and tag this thread.
elaine: ack, uploading traces after run.
yusuf: will open PR with flags and revert steps.
morgan: creating tickets and RFC for opt-out flow now.
samir: thanks all. :rocket:
